name: Serve Others
overview: Scripture reveals that serving others is central to the Christian life, modeled supremely by Christ who came not to be served but to serve and give His life as a ransom for many (Matthew 20:28; Mark 10:45). True greatness in the kingdom of God is found in humble service, as Jesus taught that the greatest among His followers will be servants (Matthew 23:11; Mark 9:35). Serving others includes acts of compassion such as feeding the hungry, giving drink to the thirsty, and welcoming strangers (Matthew 25:35), and extends even to loving and doing good to enemies without expecting anything in return (Luke 6:35). This teaching calls believers to reflect God's kindness by selflessly meeting the needs of others in love.
